title: Kasbah of the Udayas

terrainReference.basis: Original source terrain near the occupied Kasbah center.

mapIdentity.provider: Named Kasbah Q2569036 and named historic physical components in OpenStreetMap.
mapIdentity.scope: Mapped OpenStreetMap wall circuits, forts, the main gate, the palace and mosque courts, and 239 residential footprints on the original Terrarium sample frame.

note: Terrain-draped rampart foundations and footprint-derived plots on the unmodified 768 m elevation field. The historic Almohad wall is about 2.5 m wide and 8–10 m high. Bab Oudaia’s southeast height follows the 1921 surveyed section.
